philippines.title: PVL on Tour: Nxled downs Galeries for back-to-back wins
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — Nxled swept Galeries Tower, 25-23, 25-23, 25-20, to book its second straight 2026 PVL on Tour win on Saturday at Polomolok Gymnasium in South Cotabato. Gel Cayuna’s playmaking continued to work wonders for the Chameleons, orchestrating a balanced attack with 16 excellent sets on top of four points as they carried the momentum from their first win over Capital1 last week in Vigan City. Myla Pablo led the way anew with 14 points on a 13-of-30 attacking clip. EJ Cariño and MJ Phillips had nine points each, while Jonah Escamillan added six points and six excellent receptions, […]...
